description: Header file defining the VideoDecoder class for AOM video decoding within the starboard shared library, including method declarations, class members, and dependencies.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class implementing a video decoder using the AOM codec, managing decoding process, buffers, and decode targets.

methods.name: VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the video decoder with codec, output mode, and graphics context provider.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with status and error callbacks.

methods.name: GetPrerollFrameCount
methods.description: Returns the number of preroll frames (8).

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder.

methods.name: UpdateDecodeTarget_Locked
methods.description: Updates the decode target with a new frame, thread-safe.
